title: Meal First, Weight Goals and Swimming

items.title: Pick the Meal Before the Food
items.why: Today Add food guesses the meal from the clock: anything before 10 AM is Breakfast, so a 3 AM snack lands in Breakfast. Both choices stop the guess. The same applies to Quick add → Log food. Scan a barcode would ask for the meal first too.

options.label: A “Which meal is this?” screen first
options.desc: Four big buttons, then the search. The meal can still be changed before adding.

options.label: No meal picked until you tap one
options.desc: The meal buttons stay at the top; search waits until one is picked.

items.title: Weight and Body-Size Goal Ideas
items.why:
Added to every adult profile’s goal ideas (Strength, Gymnastics and Custom). Under 18 they stay hidden, as you picked for “Lose fat” in review 2; say so in the note if you want that changed.

The pace comes from the CDC: people who lose weight “gradually and steadily (about 1 to 2 pounds per week)” are more successful at keeping it off. I read that on the CDC page as archived in 2018; before shipping I’d confirm the live cdc.gov page still says it, and cite it on screen.

options.label: Clear numbers at a steady pace
options.desc:
• Lose 4 lb (2 kg) in 4 weeks
• Lose about 1 lb (0.5 kg) a week for 4 weeks
• Reach my calorie target 5 days a week

options.label: Body size, without numbers
options.desc:
• Take an inch off my waist
• Fit my clothes more comfortably
• Feel lighter on my feet

items.title: Gentler Goal Ideas for Swimming
items.why:
Rewritten from your note (“way less intense”). Ideas a Custom profile that picked Swimming would see:
• Swim 2 lengths without stopping
• Swim once or twice a week for 4 weeks
• Float on my back for 30 seconds
• Try one new stroke
